Task description: Place the black shoe with a curved white sole on the right side of the view onto the blue rectangular mat below and near the center, meeting the specified position and orientation.

Success criteria: Place the shoe near the center of the blue mat in the specified target orientation, with both grippers open and releasing it. The materials specify neither the shoe's reference point nor the toe direction in the target pose. Do not arbitrarily require the toe or heel to align with the mat center, or consider any orientation on the mat sufficient.

## Execution tips

- Consider grasping the thicker edge near the rear side of the shoe opening, with one finger inside and one against the outside. Avoid the tongue and laces where possible to reduce slipping after catching a soft protruding part.
- Set the gripper opening to match the thickness of the shoe edge and the space at the opening. Before closing, confirm that the inner finger actually enters the shoe opening and that both fingers enclose the edge; avoid mistaking image overlap for a grasp.
- When reorienting, leave clearance between the shoe sole and table and allow room for the toe and heel to rotate. Avoid brushing the small blue object behind the mat or nearby bottles and cans.
- Release only after the shoe sole is supported by the mat. When withdrawing the finger from inside the shoe opening, follow the opening to avoid catching the shoe edge and shifting the shoe.
